title: Transformers in 60 seconds
caption: Transformers in 60 seconds: the architecture behind modern language models, and the one idea at its centre, attention.

scenes.say: The cat sat on the mat because it was tired. Who was tired? You knew instantly. A model has to work it out.

items.title: Look
items.text: every word looks at every other
items.say: Every word looks at every other word.

items.title: Weigh
items.say: It weighs which ones matter. For the word it, the cat matters most.

items.title: Stack
items.say: Then it repeats that, layer after layer.

scenes.code:
The cat sat on the mat because it was

→ tired
→ hungry
→ warm
scenes.say: At the end, it predicts the next token. Then it adds that token and does it again.
Because every word is processed in parallel, they train fast on huge amounts of text. That's a transformer.
